directoryPath.title: WorkbenchDirectoryPath
directoryPath.$comment: The independent bindings additionally enforce the 4096-byte UTF-8 limit.

terminalGeometry.$comment: Semantic validation additionally requires columns * rows <= 262144, columns * cellPixelWidth <= 65535, and rows * cellPixelHeight <= 65535. The cellPixelWidth/cellPixelHeight pair must be either both positive (pixels known) or both zero (pixels unknown); a mixed pair is invalid.

reference.$comment: Independent bindings additionally enforce the 1024-byte UTF-8 bound.

progress.$comment: Independent bindings require checkout.path to equal progress.path whenever checkout is present.
